content_markdown:
# The Art of Game Design: A Book of Lenses

## 基本信息

- 作者：Jesse Schell
- 年份：2019
- 类型：book
- 来源：Schell Games / CRC Press

## 摘要

以“镜头”问题库组织游戏设计审查，从体验、玩家、机制、界面、故事、世界、团队、技术、商业到伦理，建立一套跨学科的高层判断框架。

## 核心要点

- 它的强项不是给固定答案，而是逼团队持续问对问题。
- 目录本身就是一套从立项到交付的评审顺序。
- 非常适合把模糊概念压回可讨论、可争论、可复盘的设计语言。

## 适用场景

最适合在立项、方向收敛、设计评审、vertical slice 复盘和跨职能沟通时使用，而不是把它当成某一个单独系统的详细教程。

## 知识定位

- 关注领域：体验设计 / 玩家动机 / 迭代方法 / 界面与反馈 / 商业与伦理
- 主要用途：高层方向收敛 / 设计评审 / 跨团队对齐 / 问题清单构建
- 推荐读法：按章通读 / 按镜头反查 / 评审会前抽读
- 价值类型：问题框架 / 评审语言 / 跨学科地图
- 最适合介入的阶段：立项 / pre-production / vertical slice review / 上线后复盘

## 分类

- 一级分类：立项与方向
- 二级输出物：游戏方向收敛
- 主题标签：设计基础 / 系统思维 / 玩家动机
- 可用性：已有私有书源，但来源待复核

sample_sections.text: TheArtGame Design of SCHELL Second Edition The Art Game Design ofThe Art Game Designof Jesse Schell Jesse Schell A Book of Lenses Second Edition The fundamentals of designing classic games from one of the world’s top designers Describes the deepest and most fundamental principles of game design Demonstrates how tactics used in board, card, and athletic games also work in top-quality video games Contains valuable insight from Jesse Schell, the former chair of the International Game Developers Association and award-winning designer of Disney online games. Features “… a marvelous introduction to game design by a true master of the form. Schell is the rarest of creatures: a gifted teacher who is also a talented and successful current game designer. This book re/f_lects Jesse’s skill at presenting information clearly and coherently, and the knowledge he has acquired as a master game designer.” —Noah Falstein , Chief Game Designer, Google “The Art of Game Design is one of a handful of books I continuously reference during production. Whether you’re just starting out or looking for ways to approach your design from a fresh perspective, this book is a must for your library.” —Neil Druckmann , Creative Director on The Last of Us at Naughty Dog Good game design happens when you view your game from as many perspectives as possible. Written by one of the world's top game designers, The Art of Game Design presents 100+ sets of questions, or different lenses, for viewing a game’s design, encompassing diverse fields such as psychology, architecture, music, visual design, film, software engineering, theme park design, mathematics, puzzle design, and anthropology. This Second Edition of a Game Developer Front Line Award winner: The Art of Game Design, Second Edition gives readers useful perspectives on how to make better game designs faster. It provides practical instruction on creating world-class games that will be played again and again. Computer Game Development
